name: The Legend of the Vampire
storyline: The game's plot is based on the confrontation between two races: Paladins and Vampires. Some are trying to bring back the sun that once disappeared, while others are doing their best to prevent the former. Paladins are often called warriors of light. When the sun left the lands of Takara, the paladins swore to the Gods to return it, and for a hundred years they have been striving to fulfill their promise. Vampires consider Takara's lands to be their home - under the cover of the hundred-year-old night, their population has greatly increased. The main enemies of vampires are the paladins, who seek to return the Sun. You will learn more about the plot from the legend.
summary: Legend of the Vampire is an RPG style game with anime visualization. In the game, you have to play as one of the vampires or paladins who fights against vampires. You will be able to fight with friends and other players, get a pet, find a companion and propose to her. Choose a mage, archer, or swordsman character type and go in search of adventures and new friends.
